lines.en: Creak creak, bone rub sound.
Wings flap, low whispers.
Eyes glow, red light blinding.
Gurgle, saliva drips.
Wings beat, flying in darkness.
Hoarse throat, low voice.
Eyes roll, staring at you.
Bones collide, echoing through the night.
Shadowy steps approach.
Hunger calls, hoarse cry.
Black blood drips from my severed neck.
My long hair trails around dry bones.
Float quietly, waiting for prey.
Empty gaze, waiting for you.
Wings flutter, ready to attack.
Hunger burning, gaze intense.
Drifting, hesitating.
Silent, yet threatening.

lines.zh: 低头沉思，仿佛有所等待。
lines.en: Head lowered, seemingly waiting.
Wings block, shadow falls.
Still, yet watching.
Waiting for chance, silently.
A gurgling laugh escapes my throat.

lines.zh: 头发垂下来遮住半张脸。
lines.en: My hair falls over half my face.
I hang motionless in midair.
My rotting lips move without sound.
Eyes lock onto you.
Turn to you, hungry gaze.
Tracking eyes, locking target.
Staring at you, craving prey.
Focused gaze, only for you.
Gaze at you, seeking weakness.

lines.zh: 我的瞳孔里映着你的脸。
lines.en: Your face is mirrored in my pupil.

lines.zh: 我隔着一层雾看你，不眨眼。
lines.en: I watch you through the fog without blinking.
Eyes flash, targeting prey.
Stare intently at you, not relaxing.
My pupils narrow to thin slits.
In twelve seconds, I'm gone.
Black tears seep from my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 视线从你头顶滑到脚边。
lines.en: My gaze slides from your head to your feet.
I drift behind you to stare.
When you look at me, I look back.
My eye whites are shot with veins.

lines.zh: 断头缓缓转向你的方向。
lines.en: My severed head slowly turns your way.
I press my face against your window.
This eye never blinks.
Wings hurt...
Body's shaking...
Flying ability damaged...
Wings can't hold...

lines.zh: 我的翅膀被扯开，时间快到了。
lines.en: My wing is torn wide — my time is nearly up.
My head is sinking lower.
Wings bleeding...
Twelve seconds is enough to see you clearly.
Wings broken...
A crack splits my skull...

lines.zh: 你似乎吸引了它的注意。
lines.en: It seems to be drawing closer.
The light on you agitates it.
It stares at you, ready to attack.

lines.zh: 它的触角在黑暗中蠕动。
lines.en: Its feelers twitch in the dark.

lines.zh: 你手中的食物引起它的兴趣。
lines.en: Your food catches its interest.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀发出轻微的响声。
lines.en: Its wings make a faint noise.

lines.zh: 它似乎在寻找新的猎物。
lines.en: It seems to be searching for a new target.

lines.zh: 我的头飞过来，牙齿先到。
lines.en: My head flies in; the teeth arrive first.
It moves slowly toward you.

lines.zh: 它的影子在你周围游荡。
lines.en: Its shadow wanders around you.
It crashes into you.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀撞在了你的头盔上。
lines.en: Its wings hit your helmet.

lines.zh: 你感到一阵剧烈的震动。
lines.en: You feel a violent jolt.

lines.zh: 它的爪子抓在了你的背包上。
lines.en: Its claws scratch at your backpack.
You are pushed away by its strength.

lines.zh: 它的身体撞破了你的防护罩。
lines.en: Its body breaches your shield.

lines.zh: 你被它的冲击波撞飞了。
lines.en: You are knocked back by its shockwave.

lines.zh: 它的翅膀击中了附近的石头。
lines.en: Its wings strike the nearby stone.
Its feelers sweep through the air.
Its shadow blocks the sunlight.
Nothing answers in the air but the wind.

lines.zh: 十二秒，我只出现十二秒。
lines.en: Twelve seconds — I only appear for twelve.
Its call echoes in the air.
It looks for a suitable mate.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为令人毛骨悚然。
lines.en: Its mating behavior is disturbing.
Its wings rub against each other.
It circles in search.

lines.zh: 我的叫声从断开的喉咙里出来。
lines.en: My call comes out of a severed throat.

lines.zh: 它的叫声在夜晚格外响亮。
lines.en: Its call is particularly loud at night.

lines.zh: 它的求偶行为似乎没有结果。
lines.en: Its mating efforts seem futile.

lines.zh: 你捡起了一个腐烂的头颅，它看起来曾是某人的珍贵之物。
lines.en: You picked up a rotten head, it once belonged to someone important.

lines.zh: 这颗头颅散发着腐臭的气息，令人作呕。
lines.en: The stench of this head is unbearable.

lines.zh: 你发现这颗头颅带有未解之谜。
lines.en: This head holds unsolved mysteries.

lines.zh: 这个头颅似乎曾是敌人的恐惧之源。
lines.en: This head was once the source of fear.

lines.zh: 捡起这颗头颅，它会带来不详的预感。
lines.en: Pick up this head, it brings ominous feelings.

lines.zh: 你注意到这颗头颅中藏有秘密。
lines.en: You notice secrets hidden in this head.

lines.zh: 这颗头颅的主人曾是一位勇敢的战士。
lines.en: The head's owner was a brave warrior.

lines.zh: 你发现这颗头颅中蕴含着力量。
lines.en: This head holds power.

lines.zh: 这颗头颅似乎与某种仪式有关。
lines.en: This head is related to some ritual.

lines.zh: 捡起这颗头颅，它会揭示一切真相。
lines.en: Pick up this head, it will reveal everything.

lines.zh: 你发现了一个活生生的目标，但你无法接近它。
lines.en: You've found a live target, but you can't get close.

lines.zh: 这颗头颅的目标近在咫尺，但你无法触及。
lines.en: The target is close, but unattainable.

lines.zh: 你瞄准了一个目标，但它似乎总是在移动。
lines.en: You're targeting a moving target.

lines.zh: 你看到了目标，但攻击它毫无意义。
lines.en: You see the target, but it's meaningless to attack.

lines.zh: 这个目标让你感到不安，但它似乎不可捉摸。
lines.en: The target unnerves you, but it's elusive.

lines.zh: 你试图锁定目标，但它总是逃脱。
lines.en: You try to lock on, but it escapes.

lines.zh: 这颗头颅的目标似乎在嘲弄你。
lines.en: The target mocks you.

lines.zh: 你无法确定目标的具体位置，但你清楚它的存在。
lines.en: You can't pinpoint the target, but you know it's there.

lines.zh: 这个目标仿佛是不可征服的，你无法靠近。
lines.en: The target is unconquerable, you can't get close.

lines.zh: 你试图捕捉目标，但它总是从你的视线中消失。
lines.en: You try to capture the target, but it vanishes from your sight.
Found you. Don't turn around.
The smell of a living one drifts over.
I hear your heartbeat.
You're under the tree; I see your shadow.
Tonight I follow you.
My head starts spinning faster.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，你的视线无法穿透它的防御。
lines.en: Aim at the target, but your sight can't penetrate its defenses.

lines.zh: 你试图瞄准目标，但它的身体不断移动。
lines.en: You try to target the moving body.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，但你不能确定它的位置。
lines.en: Target the body, but its location is uncertain.

lines.zh: 你对准了目标，但它的存在令人不安。
lines.en: You target the body, but it unnerves you.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，但它的外表让你犹豫。
lines.en: Target the body, but its appearance hesitates you.

lines.zh: 你紧紧瞄准目标，但它似乎总在变化。
lines.en: You focus on the target, but it keeps changing.

lines.zh: 你对准目标，但它的影子让你难以瞄准。
lines.en: You aim at the target, but its shadow confounds you.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，但它的形状似乎在变化。
lines.en: Target the body, but its shape shifts.

lines.zh: 你对准目标，但它的位置让你感到困惑。
lines.en: You aim at the target, but its position confuses you.

lines.zh: 瞄准目标，但它的存在让你难以忍受。
lines.en: You target the body, but its presence is intolerable.
I open my mouth for your neck.
My teeth grind together.
My severed neck stretches toward you.

lines.zh: 我一点点降到你肩膀那么高。
lines.en: I lower myself bit by bit to your shoulder height.
My grin splits to my ears.

lines.zh: 我只撑十二秒，够吓你了。
lines.en: Twelve seconds is all I need to scare you.
I hover right above you.

lines.zh: 我的呼吸吹凉你的后颈。
lines.en: My breath chills your neck.
The chewing sound grows closer.
Don't close your eyes. I'm here.

lines.zh: 我扑下去，牙齿先碰到你。
lines.en: I dive and my teeth touch you first.
My severed neck stretches half a block.

lines.zh: 我的头发缠住你的手腕。
lines.en: My hair tangles around your wrist.
I whip my severed neck across your face.
My scales are deadly!
Feel my breath!

lines.zh: 我只剩十二秒，够咬一口。
lines.en: Twelve seconds left — enough for one bite.
Twelve seconds — enough to hit you.
You can't escape, yield!
I sink my teeth into your shoulder!
My head slams into your chest!
My teeth tear through flesh!
I spin and bite at you!
I lash you with my severed neck!
My hair coils around your wrist!
I bite off a piece and flee!
A shadow in the darkness...
Sss, it's a Flying Head!
It descends from the sky...
Something in the sky...
Beware, it's here...
Eyes in the darkness...

lines.zh: 天空中有个移动的阴影...
lines.en: A moving shadow in the sky...
Something is moving in the darkness...

lines.zh: 天空中有个恐怖的存在...
lines.en: A horror in the sky...

lines.zh: 天空中的阴影越来越近...
lines.en: The shadow in the sky is getting closer...
Bones rattle somewhere far off.
A head drifts out from behind a tree.
A face appears in the night.
The wind stops. It's here.
Something hangs above your head.
Bone-clicking comes closer.
It pokes its head out of the fog.
A head now sits on the rooftop.
Its hair drifts in first.
The candle flickers, and it appears.
I burn, and only twelve seconds remain.
Fell down...
Underwater, I choke and can't speak...
The blast twists my face...

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的断颈，没有流血。
lines.en: The arrow passes through my severed neck without blood.
Twelve seconds. I'll float a while longer.
Hunger caves in my scalp...
My head is smoking from the hit.

lines.zh: 我掉出世界边界，还在笑。
lines.en: I drop past the world border, still grinning.
